reason: Provider documents that this historical alias sends generation requests to Gemini 3.8 Flash, so it cannot provide a separately labelled Gemini 3.7 benchmark.

sources.finding: The provider describes this model as deprecated and says requests using this name are redirected to Gemini 3.8 Flash.
The deprecation table retains the endpoint as a redirect rather than an independent model.

limitations: The native metadata GET returned a historical 3.7 model card with HTTP 200. That does not contradict or verify the documented generation redirect.
No generation call was made to verify the routed model identity; the redirect conclusion relies on provider documentation.
This is a setup availability outcome, not an inference result or evidence of model quality.
